title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: Right ankle and foot of a supine patient from above: leg at the top, toes at the bottom, lateral (little toe) on the image left, medial (big toe) on the right.
teachingPoint: Linear probe transverse over the anterior ankle between the malleoli, across the course of the anterior tibial artery; needle in-plane from lateral, entering just beyond the probe's lateral end.
claims: Right ankle and foot from above, lateral on the left - the same way round as a transverse ultrasound and the anatomy plate.
Linear probe transverse over the anterior ankle (record, steps 1), at the level of the malleoli (added).
Red dashes: the surface course of the anterior tibial artery continuing as the dorsalis pedis to the first intermetatarsal space (standard anatomy, added); the probe crosses it.
Needle entering just lateral to the probe, in line with it (in-plane from lateral; added - the record does not name the approach).
Three labels: Lateral malleolus, Medial malleolus, Dorsalis pedis.
